tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground. Ash black in dark (the default), mist in light: both carry the ash hue at 6% saturation, so the page reads neutral with a trace of green-grey. Every mode sits on it.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cells that need lift: the hero side panel, notes, inputs, tooltips. Separated by `rule`, never a shadow.

tokens.name: ground-sunk
tokens.usage: Code wells, table headers, the trace panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, names, values, the current nav item and the secondary button outline (13:1 on ground in both themes). Long prose uses `ink-body`.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running prose and ledes (10:1 on ground in both themes), one step under `ink` so headings stand out without bold colour.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Mono labels, metadata, captions, secondary copy on any ground (5.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only: frame rails, crop marks, input borders, ticks (3.5:1+). Never body text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between cells and rows inside the frame. Decorative; use `ink-faint` when the line must be seen.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill (inverted label, ink button).

tokens.name: char
tokens.usage: Deepest surface: optional full-bleed dark bands on product pages, the favicon ground. Text on it uses `ash-50`. Carried from v1: on the ash ground it now sits lighter than the page.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Paper props: the printout and continuous-form sheets. A prop, so it stays light in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text typed on paper props.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper props.

tokens.name: paper-rule
tokens.usage: Sprocket-hole perforation lines and rules on paper.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Field-report card stock, the warm counterpart to ash paper. One clipped report per page, featured in the workbench.

tokens.name: kraft-ink
tokens.usage: Body text on kraft.

tokens.name: ash-50
tokens.usage: Brand ash, lightest. Text on `char`.

tokens.name: ash-100
tokens.usage: Brand ash. The flame's lit edge in dark.

tokens.name: ash-300
tokens.usage: Brand ash, the favicon's flame colour. The flame body in dark.

tokens.name: ash-500
tokens.usage: Brand ash, mid. Illustration and chart neutrals.

tokens.name: ash-700
tokens.usage: Brand ash, deep. Illustration shadows.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Ember as a mark: chart series, the hot cell, tag swatches, meter ticks, the commit square, the current page's underline. The Ember Calm ember, softened from v1. 3.3:1 or better on every ground. Never carries text; text-bearing fills use `ember-strong`.

tokens.name: ember-strong
tokens.usage: Ember as a fill that carries text: the primary button, a filled callout. With `on-ember` (white) it passes WCAG 2 and APCA in both themes.

tokens.name: ember-ink
tokens.usage: Ember as text or a line on the ground: data links, deltas, live values. The dark value is the Ember Calm ember lifted to APCA Lc 60, as v1 did, because 12px mono text needs it (5.5:1 or better on every ground in both themes).

tokens.name: ember-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet ember background: highlighted row, text selection. `ember-ink` and `ink` read on it.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on `ember-strong` (buttons, filled callouts). White passes both WCAG 2 (4.97:1) and APCA (Lc 79) on it.

tokens.name: infra
tokens.usage: Domain mark for infra: tags' swatch, chart series, bars. A mark, never a text background (3.6:1 or better on every ground).

tokens.name: infra-ink
tokens.usage: Infra as text or a line (6.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: infra-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet infra background: tag fill, selected row.

tokens.name: on-infra
tokens.usage: Large text (24px+) on an `infra` fill only. Prefer `infra-wash` with `infra-ink` for anything small.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Frost: links in running text, nav hovers and the focus ring (5.3:1 or better on every ground in both themes). The one cool accent beside ember. Ember is never a link colour.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords in code blocks, at weight 600. Syntax colour is the one place colour may mark kind rather than domain or state, and only in ink, `infra-ink` and `data-ink`.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings in code blocks: violet, the one hue code may use.

tokens.name: code-constant
tokens.usage: Numbers, constants and literals in code blocks.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Functions and parameters in code blocks.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments and punctuation in code blocks.

tokens.name: data
tokens.usage: Domain fill for data (pipelines, pricing, quant, grid desk, FPL). Muted violet, its own hue so data never reads as ember (signal) or amber (warn). A mark, never a text background (4.4:1 or better on every ground).

tokens.name: data-ink
tokens.usage: Data as text or a line (7.2:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: data-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet data background: tag fill, selected row. `data-ink` and `ink` read on it.

tokens.name: on-data
tokens.usage: Text on a `data` fill.

tokens.name: play
tokens.usage: Domain fill for play (football, music, riding, photos). Play takes no hue; it is ink.

tokens.name: play-ink
tokens.usage: Play as text.

tokens.name: play-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet play background.

tokens.name: on-play
tokens.usage: Text on a `play` fill.

tokens.name: signal-live
tokens.usage: State: up, healthy, shipped. Always with a word (status:up).

tokens.name: signal-warn
tokens.usage: State: degraded, stale. Always with a word.

tokens.name: signal-error
tokens.usage: State: down, failed. Always with a word; never told apart from live by hue alone.

tokens.name: flame-outline
tokens.usage: Mark only: the first pixel of every row of the flame body, a darker left edge that gives it shading.

tokens.name: flame-body
tokens.usage: Mark only: the rest of the flame body.

tokens.name: flame-shadow
tokens.usage: Mark only: the ember offset layer, the flame's silhouette shifted 1px down and right, showing wherever the body doesn't cover it. The brand orange from notedwin.com, kept exact; logos are exempt from contrast minimums.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per surface at most, never on the home page. Instrument Sans at 88% width.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: My name is Edwin. I learn by taking things apart.
styles.usage: The home intro and a post or page summary, at most `lede-measure` wide (44ch, the same width as `measure` at body size); the second paragraph in `ink-muted`. Instrument Sans at 96% width.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page and post titles. Instrument Sans at 90% width. Below 768px use `h1-sm`.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-sections, row and project titles. 21px, two steps above `body` and clear of the 19px `lede`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every paragraph has to earn its place.
styles.usage: Long-form prose in `ink-body`, at most `measure` wide (50ch, about 70 characters of Instrument Sans). Weight `--sans-weight`: 420 in ash, 400 in mist.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Card titles in a grid (post cards, read next). Clamp to three lines where a page must stay one screen.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name in the header lockup, beside the flame at 32px. Lowercase, never in the pixel face.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section titles on the site (`workbench`, `field photos`, `log`), lowercase, over a `rule`. Also prose `h4` and below, so a small heading changes face instead of passing for a bold paragraph.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav links, text buttons and inline actions (`all posts →`). `ink-muted` at 400; the current page is `ink` at 600 with an underline (400 and 600 are separate font files, so the weights really differ).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Project meta lines, the route line, button labels.

styles.name: report
styles.usage: Field-report titles on kraft, uppercase. The only uppercase in the system.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Technical text only: log dates, figure captions, section notes, tags and status, the commit line, footer links. Lowercase. Departure Mono is a pixel face: always a multiple of 11px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, tight list gaps, inline groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button vertical rhythm; dense table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; panel padding; workbench grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; note padding; gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between trail-log entries; between paragraphs groups and figures.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between major page regions; field-notes outer margin.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top margin; end-of-page breathing room before the sign-off.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between major sections on the home page; hero top margin.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: panels, blocks, buttons, images. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and tags only, to soften small hit targets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and nothing else.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. One shadow exists, for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, command palette. Nothing resting on the page gets a shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Prose width: about 70 characters of Instrument Sans at body size (its zero is wide, so 66ch ran to 85).

tokens.name: lede-measure
tokens.usage: Lede width: 44ch at 19px is the same width as `measure` at body size.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: Width between the rails on the site (home, log, posts), with `space-12` padding inside each rail.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Width between the two frame rails on product and app pages.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Left label column width inside the frame at 1024px+.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule, rail and border.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid `link` (frost), 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: mark-px
tokens.usage: The flame's native grid (plus 1px for the offset layer). Render it only at whole multiples: 16, 32, 48, 64, 192.

tokens.name: cube
tokens.usage: Edge of the home cube; its stage is 200px square with 700px perspective.
